title: A member on a pause the desk approved still gets 'We haven't seen you, come in when you can'
what: A member asks the desk to pause their plan for the weeks they are away, and the desk approves it (the phone shows 'Your plan is paused'). The automatic reminders never look at that pause. Fourteen days (or the gym's number) after the last check-in, the phone still pops up 'We haven't seen you for 14 days. Come in when you can.' while the member is on the very break the gym agreed to. The phone holds the approved pause dates, but only the plan card reads them.
expected: While an approved pause runs, the 'we haven't seen you' reminder is not sent; the count of days away starts again after the pause ends.
who: members who pause their plan through the app
how_often: every approved pause longer than the gym's 'not seen' days
fix_line: Let the reminder planner skip the 'not seen' reminder while an approved pause runs

title: Once the Pro lock is on, a Starter gym's old diet plans stay on the member's phone as if current and never update
what: When a gym is on Starter, the leaderboard and the workout of the day disappear from the member app. The diet plans do not: the phone simply stops asking the gym and keeps showing the last diet plan it saved, with nothing saying it no longer updates. A diet the trainer changes later never reaches the member, who keeps following the old one. Leaving the gym does remove the diet plans, so only this case keeps them. Dormant today because the Pro lock is off for everyone.
expected: When the gym's pack does not include diet plans, the phone hides or removes the saved diet plans (as it does on leave), or clearly says they are no longer kept up to date.
who: members of a gym that moves to Starter
how_often: every time, once the Pro lock is on
fix_line: Drop or label the saved diet plans when the gym's pack closes them
